Container.Name: resilio-sync-container
Container.Overview: Resilio Sync v3: Hardened, reproducible GNU Guix / Nix + zero-dependency Rust Resilio Sync v3 (3.1.2.1076) P2P synchronization appliance for Unraid, Synology NAS, and Fedora Server. Features fail-closed JSON & v3 key-whitelist validation, live http.port health probing, top-level /config, /users, /shared, /other, and /downloads mounts, and non-recursive data ACL preservation.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Resilio Sync v3 WebUI HTTP Port (/gui/)

Config.Name: Sync Listening Port (TCP)
Config.Description: Resilio Sync P2P data transfer listening port (TCP)

Config.Name: Sync Listening Port (UDP)
Config.Description: Resilio Sync P2P uTP data transfer listening port (UDP)

Config.Name: Health & Telemetry API Port
Config.Description: JSON Health & Sync Telemetry API (/status) — collision-free with manta (9199), barracuda (9299), and urchin (9399)

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent Resilio Sync configuration and SQLite state directory (/config/storage)

Config.Name: Users Share Path
Config.Description: Top-level /users share directory (never touched by recursive chown/chmod)

Config.Name: Shared Share Path
Config.Description: Top-level /shared directory (never touched by recursive chown/chmod)

Config.Name: Other Share Path
Config.Description: Top-level /other directory (never touched by recursive chown/chmod)

Config.Name: Downloads Share Path
Config.Description: Top-level /downloads directory and default folder destination (never touched by recursive chown/chmod)

Config.Description: Device name displayed to Resilio Sync peers and WebUI

Config.Name: Health Bind Address
Config.Description: Bind address for the :9198/status telemetry server (set to 127.0.0.1 when using --network=host)
